risks: No explicit DAG prerequisites is not proof of implementation readiness: published identity/ACL/command and container migration gates are mandatory.
Working-tree evidence may become stale during root integration; sourceReferences hashes are not a claim that uncommitted files match input HEAD.
SharedWithMe cannot be derived from PageConfig.share (public publication), Page action grants (source capability authorization), entity.permissions, or caller-supplied granted:true.

Current generated native live receipts describe native availability, not actual entity-scoped authorization or a completed domain transaction; retain honest saved/queued/committed/provider-confirmed distinctions.
Updating page.json for opened/favorite would corrupt Recent semantics by bumping updatedAt; contentDigest is a checksum/security binding, not a global File or document ID.
Workspace-wide LoadedPage snapshots, stale private pin titles and unfiltered facet totals can leak metadata even when row UI is filtered.
ProjectAsset filename/absolutePath and SessionFile path are mutable native aliases; using them as global IDs or moving arbitrary session-folder files violates the specification.
Current deletePage is physical deletion, not trash. Reusing it under a trash label silently loses retention and tombstone semantics.
Editable Doc/New/Templates readiness is a real acceptance gate; Page/File-first delivery or child Notes/Wiki scheduling cannot turn the Doc DoD into N/A or featureComplete=true.
The exact browser spec runner/location is not established by published basename; lead must accept tests/rox-suite/drive-library.spec.ts placement and supported runner before execution.
Malformed/checksum-failed/scanning/quarantined uploads must never open as ready. Fixture scan states are not evidence of a real scanner or provider read-back.
Specification mentions PagesView, but the inspected actual library/detail dispatch is MainContentPanel's isPagesNavigation branch. Integrate the real seam rather than creating a duplicate surface.
Current semantic UI font is Arial Narrow with Rox monospace tokens; package must inherit selected semantic styles and not impose another global font.
No runtime, seeded-failure sensitivity, reload, concurrency, UI or provider result was verified in this report. The product remains incomplete/unverified.
